class LRUCacheNode:
    """
    Represents a node in the doubly-linked list used for LRU cache.
    
    Attributes:
        key: The cache key
        value: The cached value
        timestamp: When the entry was created/updated
        ttl: Time-to-live in seconds
    """
    
    def __init__(self, key: Any, value: Any, ttl: Optional[float] = None):
        """
        Initialize a cache node.
        
        Args:
            key: The cache key
            value: The cached value
            ttl: Time-to-live in seconds (None means no expiry)
        """
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.timestamp = time.time()
        self.ttl = ttl
    
    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """
        Check if the node has expired based on its TTL.
        
        Returns:
            True if the node has expired, False otherwise
        """
        if self.ttl is None:
            return False
        return time.time() - self.timestamp > self.ttl
    
    def get_remaining_ttl(self) -> Optional[float]:
        """
        Get the remaining time-to-live for this node.
        
        Returns:
            Remaining TTL in seconds, or None if no TTL is set
        """
        if self.ttl is None:
            return None
        remaining = self.ttl - (time.time() - self.timestamp)
        return max(0, remaining)
    
    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        """Return a string representation of the node."""
        return f"LRUCacheNode(key={self.key}, value={self.value}, ttl={self.ttl})"
